description: Unit tests for HuffmanBuilder class, verifying Huffman encoding properties and tree serialization.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoPrefixCollision
methods.description: Test that no Huffman representations are prefixes of each other.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.NoMissingInputs
methods.description: Test that all used characters have representations and no extra are created.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.OptimalCodeOrder
methods.description: Test that higher frequency characters have shorter or equal length codes.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVector
methods.description: Test that ToVector produces the expected Huffman Tree serialization.

methods.name: HuffmanBuilderTest.ToVectorSingle
methods.description: Test that a single-element tree is correctly serialized with an appended node.
